resource_load.note: Up to 3 DB queries: issue lookup, issue_watch check, repo watch fallback
4 queries: issue lookup, get watchers, get users by IDs, count watchers

performance_issues.description: GetIssueWatchers returns user IDs, then GetUsersByIDs fetches users separately. The watcher query already JOINs user table but doesn't return user data.
performance_issues.impact: Extra query for user details that could be fetched in the JOIN
performance_issues.recommendation: Modify GetIssueWatchers to return user data directly from the JOIN

optimization_recommendations.description: Combine watcher query and user fetch into single query returning user data
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Modify GetIssueWatchers to select user columns in the existing JOIN

resource_load.note: Heavy endpoint: count + list PRs, load repos, issues, labels, posters, attachments, milestones, assignees, reviews, branch SHAs, open git repo

performance_issues.description: ToAPIPullRequests opens a git repository and iterates over PRs to get base branch SHA, checking branch existence for each head repo
performance_issues.impact: For N PRs with different base branches, N branch lookups occur. Git repo open is expensive.
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch load all needed branches in one query before the loop (already partially cached with baseBranchCache)

performance_issues.description: Multiple sequential DB queries to load related data (labels, posters, milestones, assignees, reviews) without caching
performance_issues.impact: Each list request triggers 8+ DB queries regardless of data freshness
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider response-level caching for frequently accessed repos with many PRs

optimization_recommendations.description: Add short-lived cache for PR list responses on high-traffic repos
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce DB load by 80%+ for repeated list requests
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Cache API response with ETag/If-None-Match support, invalidate on PR state changes

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch load all branch SHAs needed for the page in one query
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce branch lookups from N to 1
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Collect unique base branch names, query all at once, populate cache

resource_load.note: PR lookup + load repos + convert (opens git repo for branch SHA)

performance_issues.description: StartPullRequestCheckOnView triggers a background queue task on GET request when PR status is 'checking'
performance_issues.impact: Side effect on read: adds task to queue, acquires global lock briefly
performance_issues.recommendation: Acceptable pattern - triggers async check, doesn't block response

resource_load.note: Resolve head repo + PR lookup by base/head + load repos + convert
PR lookup + load base repo + git diff/patch operation (potentially large output)

performance_issues.description: Diff/patch output is streamed directly to response with no size limit. Large PRs with many changes can produce very large responses.
performance_issues.impact: Memory and bandwidth consumption proportional to diff size, no cap
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider adding a max-size limit or pagination for very large diffs

optimization_recommendations.description: Add optional size limit parameter for diff downloads
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Prevent OOM on extremely large PRs
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Add max_size query param, truncate output with indicator when exceeded
